params.meaning: spine joint the part hangs from (soft bodies: unused)

params.name: at.side
params.meaning: -1 left, +1 right, 0 on the midline; set by mirror

params.name: at.offset
params.meaning: offset in the joint frame, x mirrored by side (a leg's shoulder, the eyes' centre)

params.name: at.slot
params.meaning: ring slot on a soft body (octopus web), 0 = the first

params.name: mirror
params.meaning: authoring sugar: expand into <id>.L (side -1) then <id>.R (side +1), the shipped leg order

params.name: count
params.meaning: copies

params.name: fromJoint
params.meaning: attach joint of the first copy

params.name: toJoint
params.meaning: attach joint of the last copy

params.name: lastScale
params.meaning: length factor at the last copy (1 = no taper)

params.name: template
params.meaning: the part to copy (any part type; its at.joint is replaced)

modules.name: Ambush
modules.summary: Rest / explore / stalk / ambush / strike / hold / retreat (OctopusBrain + prey adapters; arm roles, grooming). Hold 1.5 s, no damage.

modules.name: ClimbExcursion
modules.summary: Approach a climbable obstacle, climb to a goal on its real surface, rest, descend (ClimbingBrain wrapping Wander).

modules.name: Flee
modules.summary: Runs straight away from the nearest threat (CreatureThreats: the viewer in play mode) once it comes within the alarm radius, sliding along the enclosure wall when cornered; calms down after it leaves. Gives the species a ModularBrain (with Wander as the idle default).

params.name: radius
params.meaning: alarm radius: a threat closer than this (planar) starts the flight

params.name: runDistance
params.meaning: how far ahead of the head the escape target lies

params.name: calmSeconds
params.meaning: keeps fleeing this long after the threat left the radius

params.name: utility
params.meaning: utility with the threat at the head (Wander idles at 0.1)

modules.name: FlightExcursion
modules.summary: Rest, Face, Patrol, Soar, Landing on perches; predictive wall turn-back (FlightBrain).

modules.name: Wander
modules.summary: Safe-disc points, walk, pause, glance (WanderBrain). Containment is structural: the head is clamped to the safe radius.

modules.name: Climb
modules.summary: Per-joint up field, real-geometry contact via ISurfaceProbe, pitch limiter (CreatureClimb, ClimbSpec). Terrain walls >= 50 deg over >= 1/2 body length (R30/R31). 0 = default for every number.

params.name: maxSurfaceAngleDeg
params.meaning: steepest surface, from gravity's up (0 = 140)

params.name: maxHeightBodyLengths
params.meaning: highest climb in body lengths (0 = 1.5)

params.name: speedFactor
params.meaning: speed factor on a vertical surface, up (0 = 0.5)

params.name: descentSpeedFactor
params.meaning: speed factor going down head-first (0 = 0.4)

params.name: clearanceFactor
params.meaning: body clearance on a wall vs walking (0 = 0.65)

params.name: strideFactor
params.meaning: stride on a wall (0 = 0.6)

params.name: stepTimeFactor
params.meaning: step time on a wall (0 = 1.2)

params.name: liftFactor
params.meaning: foot lift on a wall (0 = 0.6)

params.name: upRateDeg
params.meaning: fastest turn of a joint's up (0 = 270)

params.name: upSmoothJoints
params.meaning: joints each side smoothed into the up field (0 = 3)

params.name: pitchLimitDeg
params.meaning: largest pitch bend between segments (0 = 25)

params.name: minWidthFactor
params.meaning: a climb goal needs a surface this many body widths across (0 = 1.5)

modules.name: Fly
modules.summary: Ground -> Launch -> Air <-> Glide -> Flare -> Touchdown -> Perched (CreatureFlight, FlightModel, AirChain). Froude-scaled. twist: the twisting Chinese-dragon air chain (AirTwist).

params.name: spec
params.meaning: flight (FlightSpec: speeds, lift/drag, altitude PID, stroke, banking, flare, air undulation) - fields: cruiseSpeed, minSpeed, maxSpeed, kGrip, vGripMin, kLift, kDrag, upstrokeArea, featherDeg, climbGain, climbDamping, climbIntegral, climbIntegralLimit, thrustGain, demandFloor, descendCutoff, glideDemand, amplitudeMin, strokeRateMin, strokeRateMax, glideRelax, maxBankDeg, bankGain, bankDamping, maxAsymmetry, rollGain, rollDamping, glideAlphaDeg, flareAlphaDeg, launchSpeed, flareDistance, minAltitude, cruiseAltitudeFrac, airUndulationDeg, airUndulationHz, tailSag, headStabilise, avoidLookahead, avoidMargin, perchGrip, perchMinRadius, pursuitGain

params.name: twist
params.meaning: twisting flight (AirTwist, Chinese dragon): the body follows the head's path; 3D swimming, corkscrews, barrel rolls, loops, slow rolls that travel head to tail. All 0 = the serpent's trailing air chain

params.name: twist.swimAmplitude
params.meaning: always-on swimming: the head's 3D S-curve amplitude (0 = no swimming)

params.name: twist.swimHz
params.meaning: swimming wave frequency; wavelength along the body = speed / Hz

params.name: twist.swimVertical
params.meaning: vertical share of the swim (0 = a flat S, 1 = as tall as wide); its own slower phase turns the S-plane

params.name: twist.swimRollDeg
params.meaning: roll into each swim curve (banking with the S), travels down the body

params.name: twist.corkscrewAmplitude
params.meaning: corkscrew: helix radius of the head's path (0 = no corkscrews)

params.name: twist.corkscrewHz
params.meaning: corkscrew: helix turns per second

params.name: twist.corkscrewTurns
params.meaning: corkscrew: helix turns per manoeuvre (0 = 3)

params.name: twist.corkscrewRolls
params.meaning: corkscrew: full body rolls over the manoeuvre (the twist travels head to tail)

params.name: twist.barrelRadius
params.meaning: barrel roll: helix radius (0 = no barrel rolls); the body rolls once, belly out

params.name: twist.barrelTime
params.meaning: barrel roll duration (0 = 1.6)

params.name: twist.loopRadius
params.meaning: loop: radius of the vertical loop (0 = no loops)

params.name: twist.loopSpin
params.meaning: loop: speed round the loop / flight speed (0 = 1); the head then surges to catch the flight line up again

params.name: twist.slowRollTime
params.meaning: slow roll: one full roll in place along the flight line (0 = no slow rolls)

params.name: twist.intervalMin
params.meaning: shortest pause between manoeuvres (0 = 4)

params.name: twist.intervalMax
params.meaning: longest pause between manoeuvres (0 = 10)

params.name: twist.uprightRateDeg
params.meaning: how fast the body rights itself onto the banked up (0 = 120)

params.name: twist.girdleBob
params.meaning: the wingbeat's shoulder bob on the twisting body: the share of the flight model's bob the girdle joint rides (0 = none: the body follows only the head's path, which never bobs)

params.name: twist.bobHead
params.meaning: share of the girdle's bob at the head (the head is stabilised; the neck blends)

params.name: twist.bobTail
params.meaning: share at the tail: behind the girdle the bob travels down the body along the path (each joint bobs as the girdle did where it is now), fading to this

modules.name: Slither
modules.summary: Lateral head wave the drag chain carries back (undulation in the walk). Long wave: lambda = speed / Hz >= 0.7 body length (R27).

params.name: undulationDeg
params.meaning: head wave amplitude

params.name: undulationHz
params.meaning: wave frequency

modules.name: Walk
modules.summary: Head steering in the tangent plane, chain, grounding, gait groups, girdle sway (CreatureSim.SubStep, CreatureLegs). The default locomotion of a spine body.

params.name: speed
params.meaning: head cruise speed

params.name: turnRateDeg
params.meaning: turn rate

params.name: accel
params.meaning: acceleration

params.name: turnSlowdown
params.meaning: speed lost in a full-rate turn

params.name: gaitSwayDeg
params.meaning: peak yaw of the trunk between girdles toward the reaching leg (0 = none)

params.name: gaitRollDeg
params.meaning: girdle roll over its planted feet

params.name: subSteps
params.meaning: fixed sub-steps per tick (cost!)

params.name: pattern
params.type: Explicit / Diagonal / Tripod / Tetrapod / Alternate / Wave
params.meaning: assigns gaitGroup to walking limbs left at -1

params.name: waveGroups
params.meaning: groups of a Wave pattern

params.name: bob
params.meaning: vertical body bounce kicked by each lift-off

params.name: bob.amplitude
params.meaning: peak dip of the body per lift-off (0 = off)

params.name: bob.hz
params.meaning: spring frequency

params.name: bob.damping
params.meaning: damping ratio (0.2 bouncy .. 1 dead)

modules.name: Chitin
modules.summary: Knee/segment bands (part 9) and a velvet sheen lobe: arthropod legs.

params.name: bandColor
params.meaning: band colour (SegmentDef.bandStart/End)

params.name: sheen
params.meaning: velvet sheen strength (0 = none)

params.name: sheenColor
params.meaning: sheen colour

modules.name: Chromatophore
modules.summary: Dynamic colour cells, flash and passing-cloud phase (octopus shader). Makes the look dynamic.

modules.name: Cloak
modules.summary: Dissolve in Forward only: the body vanishes, shadow + SSAO stay (the user's favourite bug). Per-instance, brain-driven, with hysteresis. Octopus today.

modules.name: Layers
modules.summary: Restyles part ids (material layers) for this species: shading model (Skin, Chitin, Membrane, Eye, Claw), tint, smoothness, and which layers (pattern, scale grain, sheen, shimmer) each has. Rows not listed keep the registry's (Kit/PartLayers.cs). A new part needs a row, never a shader edit.

params.name: rows
params.meaning: rows, one per restyled part id

params.name: rows[].partId
params.meaning: the part id (material layer) this row styles: 0 body, 1 limb, 2 foot/claw/cone, 3 eye, 8 membrane, 9 band, 10+ new parts (CATALOGUE.md registry)

params.name: rows[].model
params.meaning: shading model: Skin, Chitin (no grain, glossy), Membrane, Eye, Claw (keratin: the tint, glossy)

params.name: rows[].noPattern
params.meaning: no pattern on this part

params.name: rows[].limbPattern
params.meaning: the limb pattern (mottle / spots) instead of the body's

params.name: rows[].noGrain
params.meaning: no scale grain

params.name: rows[].fineGrain
params.meaning: the limbs' smaller scales

params.name: rows[].noSheen
params.meaning: without the velvet sheen (Chitin module)

params.name: rows[].noShimmer
params.meaning: without the iridescent shimmer (Shimmer module)

params.name: rows[].tintSource
params.type: Own / Pattern / Band / Dorsal / Belly / Membrane
params.meaning: tint colour: Own (tint below) or a palette colour

params.name: rows[].tint
params.meaning: the row's own tint (tintSource Own)

params.name: rows[].tintAmount
params.meaning: albedo -> tint after the pattern (Claw: how much of the tint)

params.name: rows[].smoothnessScale
params.meaning: Chitin / Claw: x the species smoothness (0 = model default: Chitin 1.6, Claw 1.9)

modules.name: Membrane
modules.summary: Translucent veined membrane (part 8, the Membrane shading model, CreatureMembrane.hlsl): wings, FinStrip fins, antennae - any part whose layer row is Membrane.

params.name: colour
params.meaning: membrane colour

params.name: translucency
params.meaning: how much light shines through

params.name: veinContrast
params.meaning: how dark the veins are

params.name: rim
params.meaning: how dark the trailing rim is

modules.name: Shimmer
modules.summary: Iridescent scale shimmer: thin-film colour bands (colour -> colour2 with the view angle) travelling head to tail along the body's back and flanks, a faint glow in each band (Creature.shader, part 0). The SkyDragon's signature; cheap (one pow, one cos per body pixel).

params.name: colour
params.meaning: colour facing the viewer

params.name: colour2
params.meaning: colour at grazing angles (the thin-film hue shift)

params.name: strength
params.meaning: strength (0 = none)

params.name: wavelength
params.meaning: distance between bands along the body (rest arc)

params.name: period
params.meaning: a band passes a point every this many seconds (x sqrt of the species scale)

params.name: glow
params.meaning: glow of the bands (emission, also in shadow)

modules.name: Skin
modules.summary: Palette dorsal/flank/belly + procedural pattern by rest arc length (CreaturePattern.hlsl); per-individual size/hue/value jitter. Layers of parts 0-2.

params.name: flank
params.meaning: flank colour

params.name: belly
params.meaning: belly colour

params.name: pattern
params.meaning: pattern colour

params.name: patternType
params.meaning: pattern

params.name: patternScale
params.meaning: pattern repeats per metre of rest arc

params.name: patternContrast
params.meaning: pattern contrast

params.name: patternSoftness
params.meaning: pattern edge softness

params.name: spotScale
params.meaning: spot size

params.name: smoothness
params.meaning: smoothness

params.name: rimStrength
params.meaning: rim light strength

params.name: subsurface
params.meaning: subsurface

params.name: sizeJitter
params.meaning: per-individual size jitter (+-), sizeScale = scale x (1 +- this)

params.name: hueJitter
